This manual covers the shop's database and the AI that reads vaccine
paperwork. It is written for the person responsible for keeping them
running. Groomers and managers do not need these procedures.

Each procedure is numbered and follows the same order: Purpose, Applies to,
Before you begin, Procedure, Result, and If something goes wrong. Reference
pages, such as SYS-01, explain how to use them instead.

## Procedures in this manual
